study: M16 S8 (d): multi-fidelity BO and the DWR estimate as fidelity indicator

problem.target: p = 5 on a mesh at the true geometry (no noise)

info.processes: one process per seed, OMP_NUM_THREADS=4, three in parallel on a 12-thread workstation (sf_p2 / sf_p3 / dwr_screened of seeds 0-1 together; mf_kg of seeds 0-2 and dwr_screened of seed 2 together, after the driver let MF-KG stop by max_cost so that its recommendation is evaluated; sf_p2 / sf_p3 of seed 2 alone)
